WHERE mt.id = #{taskId} AND mt.business_type = 2 AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT execution.id AS executionId, builder.ws_phone AS builderAccountPhone, marketer.ws_phone AS marketingAccountPhone, execution.group_name AS groupName, execution.group_jid AS groupJid, execution.group_invite_url AS groupInviteUrl, execution.group_status AS groupStatus, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_pull_marketing_execution_material relation WHERE relation.execution_id = execution.id AND relation.entry_status = 2 ), 0) AS materialJoinedCount, execution.group_member_count AS groupMemberCount, COALESCE(target.sent_message_count, 0) AS sentMessageCount, pull_task.speak_permission AS speakPermission, pull_task.builder_exit_enabled AS builderExitEnabled, execution.builder_exit_status AS builderExitStatus, execution.marketer_admin_status AS marketerAdminStatus, execution.execution_status AS executionStatus, execution.current_stage AS failureStage, execution.failure_reason AS failureReason, target.status AS marketingSendStatus, target.last_sent_at AS lastSentAt, execution.group_created_at AS groupCreatedAt FROM group_pull_marketing_execution execution JOIN group_pull_marketing_task pull_task ON pull_task.marketing_task_id = execution.task_id AND pull_task.tenant_id = execution.tenant_id LEFT JOIN account builder ON builder.id = execution.builder_account_id AND builder.tenant_id = execution.tenant_id AND builder.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN account marketer ON marketer.id = execution.marketing_account_id AND marketer.tenant_id = execution.tenant_id AND marketer.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN marketing_task_target target ON target.id = execution.marketing_target_id AND target.tenant_id = execution.tenant_id WHERE execution.task_id = #{taskId} AND execution.group_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY execution.id ASC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, s.account_state AS accountState, s.login_state AS loginState FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id JOIN account_group source_group ON source_group.id = a.account_group_id AND source_group.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN marketing_account_occupancy occupancy ON occupancy.account_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.account_group_id = #{builderGroupId} AND s.account_state = 2 AND s.login_state = 1 AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND (s.mute_status IS NULL OR s.mute_status = 2) AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) != '' AND source_group.marketing_occupancy_task_id IS NULL AND occupancy.account_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_pull_marketing_execution own_execution WHERE own_execution.task_id = #{taskId} AND own_execution.builder_account_id = a.id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_pull_marketing_execution active_execution WHERE active_execution.active_builder_account_id = a.id ) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS accountId, a.ws_phone AS wsPhone, a.protocol_id AS protocolId, a.protocol_account_id AS protocolAccountId, s.account_state AS accountState, s.login_state AS loginState FROM account a JOIN account_state s ON s.account_id = a.id AND s.tenant_id = a.tenant_id JOIN account_group marketing_group ON marketing_group.id = a.account_group_id AND marketing_group.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_account_stat stat ON stat.task_id = #{taskId} AND stat.account_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.account_group_id = #{marketingGroupId} AND s.account_state = 2 AND s.login_state = 1 AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND (s.mute_status IS NULL OR s.mute_status = 2) AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) != '' AND marketing_group.marketing_occupancy_type = 2 AND marketing_group.marketing_occupancy_task_id = #{taskId} AND COALESCE(stat.reserved_group_count, 0) + COALESCE(stat.joined_group_count, 0) < #{limit} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1

UPDATE group_pull_marketing_execution SET group_jid = #{groupJid}, group_status = 1, group_created_at = #{createdAt}, execution_status = 2, current_stage = #{nextStage}, stage_retry_count = 0, next_execute_at = #{nextExecuteAt}, updated_at = #{createdAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status IN (1, 2) AND current_stage = #{expectedStage} AND group_jid IS NULL

UPDATE group_pull_marketing_execution SET group_link_id = #{groupLinkId}, group_invite_url = #{inviteUrl}, group_member_count = #{memberCount}, failure_reason = CASE WHEN #{reason} IS NULL OR #{reason} = '' THEN failure_reason ELSE LEFT(CONCAT_WS(';', NULLIF(failure_reason, ''), #{reason}), 255) END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 2 AND current_stage = 8
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_pull_marketing_execution_material WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND entry_status = 2

SELECT task.tenant_id AS tenantId, task.id AS taskId FROM marketing_task task JOIN group_pull_marketing_task pull_task ON pull_task.marketing_task_id = task.id WHERE task.deleted_at IS NULL AND task.business_type = 2 AND task.status = 2 AND task.task_end_at > #{now} AND pull_task.resource_status = 2 AND pull_task.block_reason IN (0, 1, 2, 3) ORDER BY task.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT execution.tenant_id AS tenantId, execution.id AS executionId FROM group_pull_marketing_execution execution JOIN marketing_task task ON task.id = execution.task_id AND task.tenant_id = execution.tenant_id JOIN group_pull_marketing_task pull_task ON pull_task.marketing_task_id = task.id WHERE task.deleted_at IS NULL AND task.business_type = 2 AND execution.execution_status IN (1, 2) AND execution.next_execute_at <= #{now} AND ( execution.current_stage <> 5 OR task.status <> 5 ) AND ( ( pull_task.resource_status = 2 AND task.status = 2 AND pull_task.block_reason IN (0, 1, 2, 3) ) OR ( execution.group_name IS NOT NULL AND ( (pull_task.resource_status = 2 AND (task.status = 5 OR pull_task.block_reason IN (4, 5))) OR pull_task.resource_status = 3 ) ) ) ORDER BY execution.next_execute_at, execution.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT task.tenant_id AS tenantId, task.id AS taskId FROM marketing_task task JOIN group_pull_marketing_task pull_task ON pull_task.marketing_task_id = task.id WHERE task.deleted_at IS NULL AND task.business_type = 2 AND task.status IN (7, 8) AND pull_task.resource_status = 3 ORDER BY task.id LIMIT #{limit}
